segments.name: Biotechnology
segments.description: A late-clinical-stage biotechnology company developing an autologous cell therapy to preserve kidney function in patients with advanced chronic kidney disease and diabetes.
segments.evidence: The Company's operations are principally managed as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The company has no approved products and no product sales revenue; it recognizes only lease revenue from third parties leasing space in its manufacturing buildings.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company does not have any product candidates approved for sale and has not generated any revenue from product sales.

changes.text: In 2025, the company completed a domestication changing its jurisdiction of incorporation from the Cayman Islands to Delaware, along with related restructuring transactions.
changes.evidence: Effective July 1, 2025 (the "Domestication Date"), the Company completed a domestication process through which it changed its jurisdiction of incorporation from the Cayman Islands to the State of Delaware (the "Domestication").
